## Overview

This directory contains infrastructure-level governance patterns for enforcing architectural standards automatically within CI/CD pipelines. These patterns implement Layers 1 and 3 of the four-layer verification architecture defined in the [Enterprise Architecture Verification Strategy](../../../strategy/white-papers/engineering/enterprise-architecture-verification-strategy.md).

These patterns convert the standards defined in Golden Paths and Verification Contracts into automated, machine-enforceable pipeline gates — shifting governance from after-the-fact human review to pre-provisioning automated enforcement.
page_texts.3:
[patterns/infrastructure/governance/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

Establish automated infrastructure governance that:

- Validates repository structure and compliance metadata against declared Golden Paths before any build resources are consumed (L1)
- Blocks non-compliant Terraform plans before any cloud resources are provisioned (L3)
- Produces machine-readable conformance evidence at every pipeline run
- Routes non-conforming output to human architectural review through a defined exception management process

## Implementation Phasing

These patterns align to Phase 2 of the [Enterprise Golden Path Strategy](../../../strategy/white-papers/engineering/enterprise-golden-path-strategy.md):

| Phase | Patterns Required | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| Phase 2 — Governance Automation | PTN-INFRA-GOV-001, PTN-INFRA-GOV-002 | Months 7–12 |

> **Note:** These patterns require the governance patterns in [governance/ai-development](../../governance/ai-development/) (especially PTN-GOV-AI-001, PTN-GOV-AI-003, PTN-GOV-AI-004) to be operational before deployment.

## Patterns in this Category

| Pattern ID | Name | Purpose | Verification Layer |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PTN-INFRA-GOV-001](./PTN-INFRA-GOV-001-architecture-conformance-gate-pattern.md) | **Architecture Conformance Gate** | Fast-fail CI/CD pipeline stage that validates repository structure against the declared Golden Path's Verification Contract before tests or deployment | Layer 1 — Build Time |
| [PTN-INFRA-GOV-002](./PTN-INFRA-GOV-002-policy-as-code-enforcement-pattern.md) | **Policy-as-Code Enforcement** | OPA/Rego evaluation of Terraform plans as a hard pre-provisioning gate that blocks non-compliant infrastructure before any cloud resources are created | Layer 3 — Pre-Deployment |

## Four-Layer Verification Architecture

These patterns implement 2 of the 4 layers:

```
L1: Architecture Conformance Gate ◄── PTN-INFRA-GOV-001 (this directory)
        ↓
L2: Architecture Fitness Functions ◄── PTN-APP-GOV-001 (application/governance)
        ↓
L3: Policy-as-Code Enforcement ◄── PTN-INFRA-GOV-002 (this directory)
        ↓
L4: Runtime Behavioral Invariant Monitors ◄── PTN-APP-GOV-003 (application/governance)
```
